topic.label: Location and Place
topic.desc: Where something is: geographic coordinates, place names, addresses, distances and routes on Earth, and the regions and jurisdictions that a place falls in. Physical location; digital locations (where software runs) are in Environments and Deployment.

concepts.label: Distance, Routing and Navigation
concepts.desc: Distance between places (great-circle and travel distance), routes, bearings and travel time by mode.

concepts.label: Place Names and Gazetteers
concepts.desc: Named places on Earth (cities, mountains, parks, rivers, landmarks) and how gazetteers resolve a place name to coordinates and a unique place.

concepts.label: Planetary and Off-Earth Location
concepts.desc: Location beyond Earth: celestial coordinates, planetary surface coordinates and the reference frames used for the Moon, Mars and spacecraft.

concepts.label: Regions and Jurisdictions
concepts.desc: Which country, state, county, city, time zone and legal jurisdiction a location falls in, and the boundaries that decide it.

concepts.label: Coordinate Systems and Projections
concepts.desc: Datums, coordinate reference systems and map projections.

concepts.label: Web Mapping and Geocoding
concepts.desc: Geocoding, map tiles and routing services for web and mobile maps.

skills.label: Distance Calculator
skills.desc: Computes great-circle distance and bearing between two coordinates or places, and travel distance when a route is known.

skills.label: Route Planner
skills.desc: Plans a route between places for a travel mode and reports distance, time and waypoints.

skills.label: Geographic Coordinate Lookup
skills.desc: Gets the geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) of a place, address or landmark, and the place at given coordinates.

skills.label: Nearby Places Finder
skills.desc: Finds places near a coordinate or place name within a radius, by type, with distances.

skills.label: Place Name Resolver
skills.desc: Resolves a place name to one place with its coordinates, type and country, and lists the alternatives when the name is ambiguous.

skills.label: Planetary Coordinate Explainer
skills.desc: Explains surface coordinates and reference frames for the Moon, Mars and other bodies, and how they differ from Earth latitude and longitude.

skills.label: Boundary Explainer
skills.desc: Explains an administrative or legal boundary and which places fall on each side.

skills.label: Jurisdiction Locator
skills.desc: Maps a location to its country, state, county, municipality and time zone, and names the authority that governs it.

skills.label: Coordinate Reference System Transformer
skills.desc: Transforms coordinates between datums and projections and reports the expected error of each transformation.

skills.label: Projection Selector
skills.desc: Selects a projection for a region and purpose by which distortion matters, such as area, distance or shape.

skills.label: Geocoder
skills.desc: Converts addresses to coordinates and back and returns the match quality of each result.

skills.label: Routing Service Integrator
skills.desc: Integrates a routing service for directions and travel times and tests edge cases such as closures and one-way streets.

skills.label: Map Tile Publisher
skills.desc: Prepares vector or raster tiles and a basemap style for web display and sets zoom levels and caching.

mcp.name: TomTom Maps
mcp.desc: TomTom maps, routing, geocoding & traffic data

mcp.name: Felt Maps
mcp.desc: Map and analyze your geospatial data

mcp.name: GIS Cloud
mcp.desc: Run your entire GIS workflow in plain language: maps, data, analysis, field apps, and reports

mcp.name: Google Maps MCP
mcp.desc: Google Maps Platform MCP server: geocoding and reverse geocoding of addresses and coordinates, place search and place details, distance matrix, elevation and directions.

mcp.name: Mapbox MCP Server
mcp.desc: Mapbox location MCP server: forward and reverse geocoding, points of interest search, directions and travel-time isochrones, static map images.

mcp.name: OpenStreetMap MCP
mcp.desc: OpenStreetMap MCP server: geocode addresses and place names to coordinates, find nearby places, route between locations, explore neighborhoods from open map data.
